This investigation is about finding numbers that have the same Number Stem.
The possible Number Stems are the nine integers from 1 to 9.
Here is how to calculate the Number Stem of a number.
Step 1 Add the digits of the number to get a total.
Step 2 If the total is 9 or less, STOP.
Otherwise, add the digits of the total.
